related_quests: The Stonelore Defense: Repel the Firesong Circle's attack on Earthen Root Enclave.
Pledge: Earthen Root Enclave: Enter Earthen Root Enclave and return Undaunted.
summary: The Corruption of Stone (originally the Spirit of Stone) is nature spirit that resides in the Earthen Root Enclave on the Dais of Stonesight. It has been corrupted by the Firesong Druids lead by Archdruid Devyric. It resembles a Storm Atronach that lacks any lightning.
